description: The funnel becomes one fixed frame. On top of 012: the four stages (Diagnosis, Virtual Role, Revenue Math, Book) now crossfade in place inside #funnel instead of stacking down the page; Back on every stage after Diagnosis and a Start-over on Book; the browse-all-industries carousel is off the home scroll and opens only from the Virtual Roles nav tab. Two rendering defects found by screenshot and fixed: every stage opened with its heading under the sticky header (stages now top-aligned with scroll-margin), and the heading focus ring spanned the full row (now hugs the text). Refocusing a search box that already holds the chosen business no longer pops the results dropdown over a later stage.

approvedBuild.note: 011 remains the approved build. 012 was committed as the baseline (6577154); 013 is the crossfade-frame revision Eric asked for and needs his eyes-on review.

qa.note: Playwright, tests/dassa-qa.spec.js, 27 tests x 7 viewport projects, run 2026-09-22: 154 passed, 0 failed, 35 skipped (pointer-only or touch-only by design). Tests updated for the frame model: only the active stage is visible, earlier stages are marked done on the rail; the carousel tests open the Virtual Roles panel first (via the hamburger below 860px); the keyboard walk stops when Tab wraps and exempts the calculator's copy-column button. Two earlier full runs were invalid: one was interrupted by test edits mid-flight, one failed 106 tests with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED because an ad-hoc screenshot server was holding port 8850. Still needs Eric: the crossfade as perceived, the band, and the hero direction the critique passes are producing.
